verse.verse_1: Al-Qari'ah (the striking Hour i.e. the Day of Resurrection),
verse.verse_3: And what will make you know what the striking (Hour) is?
verse.verse_4: It is a Day whereon mankind will be like moths scattered about,
verse.verse_5: And the mountains will be like carded wool,
verse.verse_6: Then as for him whose balance (of good deeds) will be heavy,
verse.verse_7: He will live a pleasant life (in Paradise).
verse.verse_8: But as for him whose balance (of good deeds) will be light,
verse.verse_9: He will have his home in Hawiyah (pit, i.e. Hell).
verse.verse_10: And what will make you know what it is?
